# Test Fixture Provenance

Every committed fixture (GGUF header, quantized block, tokenizer vector, logits snapshot) must have a row here. A fixture without provenance is not acceptable evidence and will be rejected at the gate.

## Required fields

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Short stable identifier used by tests |
| `path` | Path relative to `tests/fixtures/` |
| `kind` | `gguf-header`, `quant-block`, `tokenizer-vector`, `logits`, `tiny-model` |
| `source` | Upstream project + version/commit (e.g. llama.cpp `@<sha>`) |
| `command` | Exact command that produced the fixture |
| `input_sha256` | Hash of the source model/prompt/input |
| `output_sha256` | Hash of the committed fixture |
| `license` | License of the upstream data and any redistribution constraint |
| `notes` | Scope, tolerance, or known limitation |

## Rules

- Prefer **small** fixtures (≤2 MB each; total ≤10 MB) and text formats.
- Tokenizer vectors must come from llama.cpp (or another independent reference), not from this repository's tokenizer.
- Quantized blocks must be extracted from a real GGUF or generated by the reference implementation, not by `quantize_*_cpu` in this repo.
- Logits snapshots must record model hash, prompt, seed, temperature (normally 0), and the exact comparison tolerance.
- If redistribution is not permitted, commit a **generator script + hashes** instead and document how to regenerate the fixture locally.
- Update this file in the same PR that adds or changes a fixture.
